title: Hilton Introduces High Performance Meetings, Placing Wellness at the Forefront of the Event Experience
summary: The new meetings framework integrates mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery into every stage of the attendee journey.

The new meetings framework integrates mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery into every stage of the attendee journey


- **Developed by Hilton in partnership with human performance consulting firm, TIGNUM, High Performance Meetings introduces a wellness-focused approach to meetings and events designed to help attendees feel and perform at their best.**
- **Building on Hilton’s World’s Most Welcoming Events initiative, High Performance Meetings serves as its wellness-focused extension, helping planners create more inclusive, engaging and meaningful gatherings while empowering attendees to feel and perform at their best.**
- **With Hilton research revealing that 67% of attendees feel less engaged when events lack meaningful downtime, High Performance Meetings prioritizes attendee wellbeing before, during and after an event.**
- **High Performance Meetings offers customizable programming, amenities and experiences tailored to the needs of planners and attendees**


**MCLEAN, Va.** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/?_gl=1*1tj6mk0*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3OTEzOTgxNjcuQ2p3S0NBancyNWZXQmhBVkVpd0FNb3BOam1Tcl8zellob25nWDVNNzZRRGFrMl9nclVDVWV6Q01qNWk2MjVvLWlIamVOTGlNZHBxTkJCb0NEcnNRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_dc*R0NMLjE3OTEzOTgxNjcuQ2p3S0NBancyNWZXQmhBVkVpd0FNb3BOam1Tcl8zellob25nWDVNNzZRRGFrMl9nclVDVWV6Q01qNWk2MjVvLWlIamVOTGlNZHBxTkJCb0NEcnNRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_au*MTcxMjYyNDQ2Ni4xNzkwMzY2MTIxLjEwNjc0MDIwNTkuMTc5MTk5ODE5NC4xNzkxOTk4MzQ3LjIwMTIwNDQyMTcuMTc5MTk5ODE5NC4xNzkxOTk4MzQ3) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the launch of[High Performance Meetings](https://www.hiltoneventreadyplaybook.com/assets/Documents/6921-High-Performance-Meetings-Planner-Playbook-v7.pdf) , a new wellness-focused framework designed to help meeting and event attendees arrive focused, stay energized and return home ready to apply what they’ve learned. Developed in partnership with TIGNUM, a consulting firm specializing in sustainable human performance, the science-backed approach incorporates mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery throughout the attendee journey.


The introduction comes as[Hilton research](https://stories.hilton.com/2026-trends-meetings-and-events) reveals that 67% of attendees feel less engaged when events lack meaningful downtime, underscoring the growing importance of wellness in creating more productive and impactful meetings.


Hilton’s High Performance Meetings - Yoga


High Performance Meetings builds on Hilton’s[World’s Most Welcoming Events](https://www.worldsmostwelcomingevents.com/) initiative, drawing on insights from[The Meetings Maximizer](https://stories.hilton.com/2025eventtrends) ** and[Why We Gather](https://stories.hilton.com/2026-trends-meetings-and-events) reports to help planners create more inclusive, engaging and meaningful gatherings. Through flexible programming, hotel amenities and strategic partnerships, participating properties can leverage wellness programs, tools and resources to translate these insights into experiences tailored to the needs of meeting planners and attendees.


“Wellness has become essential to how people live and travel, and those expectations don't disappear when they're attending meetings and events,” said Amanda Al-Masri, vice president, wellness, Hilton. “Our role is to make it easier for guests to maintain the routines that help them feel their best, wherever their travels take them. High Performance Meetings extends that approach to group experiences, making wellness a more intentional part of how people gather, connect and collaborate.”


## A New Approach to the Attendee Journey


Drawing on human performance principles traditionally applied to elite performers and business leaders, the High Performance Meetings framework supports mental agility, sustained energy and resilience across three stages of the event experience:


- **Arrive Ready:** Pre-event resources, including enhanced "Know Before You Go" communications, travel readiness guidance and intentional arrival experiences help attendees feel prepared and ready to engage.
- **Stay Ready:** Thoughtfully structured agendas and tailored wellness experiences help attendees maintain energy, focus and engagement throughout the event, balancing productive working sessions with opportunities to recharge.
- **Return Ready:** Reflection tools, re-entry resources and post-event guidance help attendees sustain momentum and carry the benefits of the experience beyond the meeting itself.


Hilton's High Performance Meetings - Smoothie Bar


At the heart of the framework are four areas that help planners bring wellness into the meeting experience:


- **Mindset:** Experiences designed to support mental clarity, focus and resilience, including mindfulness activities, guided meditation, breathwork and opportunities for reflection.
- **Nutrition:** Thoughtfully designed food and beverage offerings that help sustain energy and support cognitive performance, with an emphasis on balanced menus, nourishing snacks, hydration and strategic meal timing.
- **Movement:** Physical activity integrated throughout the agenda, from stretching and movement breaks to fitness classes and recreational experiences, helping attendees stay energized and engaged.
- **Recovery:** Intentional opportunities for rest and restoration, including dedicated downtime, spa and recovery therapies, relaxation spaces and activities that support both physical and mental wellbeing.


Together, these elements provide a flexible approach that can be implemented across a wide range of Hilton properties, allowing hotels and planners to incorporate wellness into the meeting experience through existing amenities, services and tailored programming that aligns with the goals of each event and the preferences of its attendees.


Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Experience - Cenote Experience


“Through World's Most Welcoming Events and our ongoing research, we've spent years listening to attendees and understanding what makes gatherings more meaningful,” said Kelly Knowlen, vice president, sales engagement and special events, Hilton. “Those insights have helped Hilton create solutions designed to make attendees glad they came and eager to return. High Performance Meetings is one of those solutions, helping people feel supported, recharge and fully participate, collaborate and connect.”


As Hilton continues to evolve its approach to meetings and events, the High Performance Meetings framework will be supported by a new guide available through Hilton’s World’s Most Welcoming Events initiative, providing planners with practical insights to incorporate wellness into their events. Additional tools and resources will be introduced in the new year to support implementation across Hilton’s portfolio of hotels.


##### FAQ: Hilton Introduces High Performance Meetings, Placing Wellness at the Forefront of the Event Experience


High Performance Meetings is Hilton's new wellness-focused approach to meetings and events, developed in partnership with human performance consulting firm TIGNUM. The framework incorporates mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery throughout the attendee journey to help participants feel and perform at their best.


High Performance Meetings supports attendee wellbeing before, during and after an event through three stages: Arrive Ready, Stay Ready and Return Ready. These include pre-event resources and travel-readiness guidance, thoughtfully structured agendas and tailored wellness experiences, and post-event resources to help attendees sustain momentum and carry the benefits of the experience beyond the meeting.


High Performance Meetings focus on four areas: mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery. Depending on the property and event, experiences may include guided meditation, breathwork, balanced menus, nourishing snacks, movement breaks, fitness classes, spa and recovery therapies, and dedicated downtime.


High Performance Meetings incorporates mindset, nutrition, movement and recovery throughout the attendee journey. Drawing on science-backed human performance principles, the framework helps attendees maintain energy, focus and engagement while providing opportunities to recharge.


High Performance Meetings is the wellness-focused extension of Hilton's World's Most Welcoming Events initiative. Drawing on insights from *The Meetings Maximizer* and *Why We Gather* reports, it helps planners create more inclusive, engaging and meaningful gatherings.


Meeting planners can access the High Performance Meetings Event Planner Playbook through[Hilton's Event Ready Playbook](https://www.hiltoneventreadyplaybook.com/assets/Documents/6921-High-Performance-Meetings-Planner-Playbook-v7.pdf) , which provides practical insights on incorporating wellness into their events. Additional tools and resources will be introduced in the new year to support implementation across Hilton's hotel portfolio.
